inlines.v: CONSTELLATE, verb intransitive [Low Latin , to shine, a star.] To join luster; to shine with united radiance or one general light. [Little used.] The several things which engage our affections shine forth and constellate in God. CONSTELLATE, verb transitive To unite several shining bodies in one splendor. [Little used.]
